name: Spring showers
story: The cold air behind the gale: a blustery northwesterly, heaped cumulus with hard white tops, sharp showers sweeping down the valleys with sunshine between. Bumpy and beautiful.
forecast: Northwest 11 kt gusting 18. Cumulus, showers 12:00-17:00, base 1300 m, 5 km in showers, 80 km between. Showers dying by evening; clear, cold night.
